entities.summary: Henry Richard Vizetelly was a British publisher and writer. He started the publications Pictorial Times and Illustrated Times, wrote several books while working in Paris and Berlin as correspondent for The Illustrated London News, and between 1880 and 1890, ran a publishing house in London, Vizetelly & Company.
